label: Restated-premise controls: three equivalences, grounding instances without the universal
paraphrase: Closed controls. (1) For all parameters, ParticipatedHasOtherCause (2b25a78c, q.44 a.1 ad 1) and ParticipatedEsseHasDistinctCause (732302a1, q.44 a.1 co.) are the same proposition (Iff.rfl). (2) For every idea frame I, MeditatorThinks I (22954087) is SelectedBearsOccurringThought (b0fd6cc1) at I's occurrence, bearing and meditator fields (Iff.rfl). (3) For every causality frame F, concreteness predicate, grounding relation and world w, SomeContingentConcreteAt F concrete w (c76b6e2c) is SomeActualContingentAt (c94b5446) on the ground profile of F with the same concreteness predicate (Iff.rfl). (4) On one three-world frame (worlds a, b, z, all mutually accessible; g exists everywhere, c and d exist at a and z and not at b; every candidate concrete; g has at a a power for whatever holds at b and at b a power for whatever holds at a, nothing else has a power): the joint absence of the concreta contingent at a is possible at a, some concrete being is contingent at a, the three single-proposition grounding premises 95bf8780, 607e94cf and 94393b5b hold at a, and the universal Aristotelian grounding principle fails (z obtaining is possible at a, fails at a, and nothing at a has a power for it). (5) The universal principle holds on the same frame when g has at every world a power for every proposition. Only these conjuncts are certified; the models are formal interpretations, not evidence about actual powers.
